name: HAUSHOF Window Cleaner Robot
description: A budget window-cleaning robot from HAUSHOF, an Amazon/Walmart marketplace house brand with no dedicated official site. Ships with a physical remote and ten spare microfiber pads. Confirmed to exist and be actively sold, but with very little independently verifiable spec data.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware — Sourcing Caveat
editorial.body: HAUSHOF's window-cleaning robot is a real, currently-listed Amazon/eBay product, but has no dedicated brand website and no reputable tech press review. The Amazon listing title alone confirms 3,800 Pa suction, automatic water spray, "AI path planning"/edge-detection branding, and a physical remote control. Battery runtime, water-tank capacity, spare-pad count, noise level, and price could not be independently confirmed.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: robotindex found no recalls, lawsuits, or safety-incident reports for this product in the sources reviewed — though that reflects an unusually thin sourcing base rather than a verified clean record: HAUSHOF has no dedicated official website found, and no reputable tech-press review of this model exists.
